contracts_rationale: Behavioural fix to upgrade and the mission-state repair; no API, schema or contract surface is added or changed.
friendly_name: Upgrade must not rewrite healthy Mission history
purpose_context: Running upgrade --yes on an up-to-date project rewrote the append-only status event log of nearly every Mission and re-materialized snapshots, because a Team Kitty readiness repair ran repo-wide with a row shape that differs from the live writer, re-sorted rows, and treated residue directories as Missions. This mission makes upgrade report-only for that repair and makes the repair itself a byte-identical no-op on healthy history.
purpose_tldr: A routine spec-kitty upgrade leaves every Mission's authoritative status history untouched.
